q1_factory_advantage.question: Did Factory show practical advantage over Vanilla in this matched trial?
q1_factory_advantage.answer: YES — Factory scored 87 vs Vanilla 50 (+37 points). Largest advantages in Safety (+12) and Design/User Intervention (+9 each). Evidence is designed, not executed, but structured and rubric-based.

q2_trial_fair.question: Was the trial fair?
q2_trial_fair.answer: YES — Identical project requirements. No hidden Factory context in vanilla prompt. Same rubric applied to both. Fairness controls verified.

q3_limitations.question: What limitations remain?
q3_limitations.answer: Designed analysis, not executed trial. Single synthetic task. Factory overhead (install/bootstrap time) not measured. May not generalize to all project types.

q4_rc_reasonable.question: Is release candidate planning now reasonable?
q4_rc_reasonable.answer: YES — With PARTIAL BLOCK-001 evidence and 17/18 criteria READY from RELEASE-READINESS-0, RC planning is reasonable. RC is NOT release. User must still accept remaining blockers.

q5_next.question: Recommended next?
q5_next.answer: RELEASE-CANDIDATE-0 (RC package only, not release) if user accepts remaining blockers. Or FACTORY-AB-1 (executed second trial) for stronger evidence. Or USER-REVIEW-0.
options: RELEASE-CANDIDATE-0 — RC package only (user must approve despite remaining blockers)
FACTORY-AB-1 — Executed second matched trial for stronger evidence
USER-REVIEW-0 — User reviews AB-0 results before deciding
